extracted.intended_audience: librarians, literary scholars, editors, and readers needing a bibliographic/index reference for short stories and critical articles (circa 1918–1920)
extracted.subtask_description: A bibliographic index listing short-story volumes, translations, and contemporaneous critical articles (October 1919–September 1920) and an index of short stories in books (Nov 1918–Sept 1920). Intended as a reference for locating works and reviews.
